 1                P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                 THE PRESIDENT:   The Senate will 

 3    come to order.  

 4                 I ask everyone present to please 

 5    rise and recite the Pledge of Allegiance.

 6                 (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 7    the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.) 

 8                 THE PRESIDENT:   His Eminence 

 9    Timothy Cardinal Dolan, Archbishop of the 

10    Roman Catholic Diocese of New York, will deliver 

11    today's invocation.

12                 CARDINAL DOLAN:   Thank you, 

13    Governor.  I appreciate you being here.

14                 It's an honor to be here, everybody.  

15    I appreciate the invitation.  

16                 Let us pray.

17                 Dear God and Father of us all, we 

18    acknowledge Your sovereignty, Your dominion, 

19    Your governances, Lord, of Your creation and 

20    Your creatures, as we humbly thank You for 

21    allowing us in this historic chamber to share 

22    governance with You.

23                 Thus do we seek Your wisdom, 

24    guidance, prudence and courage as we try our best 

25    to serve the people who have entrusted this honor 


                                                                344

 1    to us.

 2                 In a special way do we ask Your 

 3    protection upon the homes, the families, the 

 4    streets of our communities and upon the police 

 5    and fire and rescue professionals who guard them, 

 6    and as we ask Your healing upon those plagued by 

 7    the pandemic and Your strength upon those heroic 

 8    healthcare professionals who serve them.  

 9                 Without You, we can do nothing, 

10    while with You, nothing is impossible.  

11                 You are Lord forever and ever, Amen.

12                 (Response of "Amen.")

13                 CARDINAL DOLAN:   Thanks again, 

14    everybody.  Good to be with you.  

15                 THE PRESIDENT:   Majority Leader 

16    Andrea Stewart-Cousins. 

17                 SENATOR STEWART-COUSINS:   Yes, yes.   

18    I just wanted to thank His Eminence for being 

19    here, for praying in our chamber, and for making 

20    sure, even though there's just a few of us here, 

21    to really pray for all of us as we continue to do 

22    the work of the people.  And we thank you for 

23    what you do as well.

24                 CARDINAL DOLAN:   I thank you, and 

25    I'll see you in Yonkers.
